name: Book Employee with Spouse — Invalid Appointment Date (Validator Rejects)
goal: User enters an appointment date that is rejected by the appointment date validator; user then provides a valid date.
constraints: First appointment date is a holiday or unavailable; validator returns isValid=false and a reason.

result.reason: Selected date is a public holiday. Please choose another date.

phases.description: User provides spouse details and appointment date.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot accepts spouse name and DOB.

phases.description: User provides appointment date that is rejected by validator.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot displays validator reason and re-prompts for appointment date.
Bot accepts and stores appointment date.
Bot confirms booking and displays selected clinic name.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
